curator_notes: Allergen & dietary safety audit: 'contains' covers core ingredients; 'may_contain' includes cross-contact risks (shared steamers, woks, mortars) and hidden seasonings like padaek (fermented fish sauce), shrimp paste, and MSG. Added 'alcohol' to constraint vocabulary. Dishes with fish_sauce, fish, shellfish, dairy, or egg in contains/may_contain have 'vegan' removed. 'vegetarian' removed if fish/shellfish/fish_sauce listed in contains/may_contain. khao_niaw and nam_anchan were deliberately assessed as clean with minor shared-kitchen may_contain flags. Allergen claims are inferred from standard traditional Lao recipes; strict user disclaimer required.

dishes.description: Steamed glutinous rice served in a woven bamboo basket (thip khao). The foundational staple eaten by hand with almost every Laotian meal.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍເຂົ້າໜຽວໜຶ່ງຕິບ
dishes.regional_note: Universal staple across all regions of Laos
dishes.notes: Eaten by rolling small balls with fingers to scoop up dips, laap, and grilled meats.

dishes.description: Hand-minced chicken tossed with mint, coriander, lime juice, chili, and toasted crushed sticky rice powder (khao khua).
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍລາບໄກ່ໜຶ່ງຈານ
dishes.regional_note: National dish of Laos, eaten everywhere
dishes.notes: Always eaten paired with fresh sticky rice and raw green herbs.

dishes.description: Shredded green papaya pounded in a mortar with red chilies, lime, garlic, and pungent unpasteurized fermented fish sauce (padaek).
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍຕຳໝາກຮຸ່ງໜຶ່ງຈານ, ບໍ່ຜັດຫຼາຍ
dishes.regional_note: Pungenter and far less sweet than Thai papaya salad (som tum)
dishes.notes: Specify 'bo phet' if you need reduced chili heat.

dishes.description: Flat rice noodles in clear pork broth topped with a rich fermented soybean and minced pork ragù paste. Served with fresh herbs.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍເຂົ້າຊອຍໜຶ່ງຖ້ວຍ
dishes.regional_note: Most associated with Luang Prabang and Northern Laos
dishes.notes: Completely distinct from Thai Chiang Mai khao soi; contains no coconut milk or curry powder.

dishes.name_local: ເຂົ້າປຽກເສັ້ນ
dishes.description: Thick handmade rice-and-tapioca flour noodles served in rich chicken or pork broth, garnished with crispy shallots and herbs.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍເຂົ້າປຽກເສັ້ນໜຶ່ງຖ້ວຍ
dishes.regional_note: Ubiquitous breakfast soup throughout all Laotian towns
dishes.notes: The starch from fresh chewy noodles naturally thickens the broth.

dishes.description: Thick herbal stew made with dried buffalo or beef, eggplants, wood ear mushrooms, sticky rice paste, and spicy sakhaan pepperwood vine.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍອໍຫລາມໜຶ່ງຖ້ວຍ
dishes.regional_note: Signature Royal heritage stew exclusive to Luang Prabang
dishes.notes: Sakhaan vine wood is chewed for a numbing, peppery sensation but not swallowed.

dishes.description: Mekong river fish marinated with lemongrass, dill, kaffir lime, and sticky rice powder, wrapped in banana leaf packets and steamed.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍໝົກປາໜຶ່ງຫໍ່
dishes.regional_note: Staple river dish across Luang Prabang and Vientiane
dishes.notes: Fragrant and delicate texture infused with fresh dill.

dishes.description: Marinated whole or halved chicken flattened on bamboo skewers and slow-grilled over white charcoal with coriander root and garlic.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍປີ້ງໄກ່ໜຶ່ງໄມ້
dishes.regional_note: Famous in Seneno and Vang Vieng road stops
dishes.notes: Best eaten alongside sticky rice and fresh green papaya salad.

dishes.description: Coarsely ground pork sausage stuffed with lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, chilies, and herbs, grilled over open coals.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍໄສ້ອົ່ວໜຶ່ງຈານ
dishes.regional_note: Luang Prabang version is rich with herbal fatty pork
dishes.notes: Distinctly herb-forward with a tart or smoky herbal aroma.

dishes.name_local: ແໜມເຂົ້ານ້ຳ
dishes.description: Deep-fried seasoned rice balls crumbled and tossed with sour fermented pork (som moo), peanuts, grated coconut, herbs, and lime.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍແໜມເຂົ້ານ້ຳໜຶ່ງຈານ
dishes.regional_note: Originating in Vientiane but common nationwide
dishes.notes: Eaten by wrapping spoonfuls inside fresh betel or lettuce leaves.

dishes.name_local: ເຂົ້າຈີ່ປາເຕ້
dishes.description: Crispy split French baguette filled with pork pâté, pork sausage, pickled carrots, cucumber, coriander, and chili sauce.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍເຂົ້າຈີ່ປາເຕ້ໜຶ່ງບາດ
dishes.regional_note: French colonial influence; sold at street stalls everywhere
dishes.notes: Generous and economical meal option for travelers.

dishes.description: Fresh freshwater riverweed pressed into sheets with garlic, tomato, and white sesame seeds, flash-fried until crisp.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍໄຄແຜ່ນໜຶ່ງຈານ
dishes.regional_note: Unique delicacy harvested from the Mekong in Luang Prabang
dishes.notes: Served hot alongside jaew bong dip for dipping.

dishes.name_en: Sweet Chili Paste with Buffalo Skin
dishes.description: Thick savory chili paste made with roasted red chilies, galangal, garlic, sugar, and shredded dried water buffalo skin.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍແຈ່ວບອງໜຶ່ງກະປຸກ
dishes.regional_note: Luang Prabang regional signature dip
dishes.notes: Buffalo skin strips provide a chewy, gelatinous texture.

dishes.description: Finely hand-minced raw beef or water buffalo mixed with fresh blood, bile juice, chili, mint, and toasted rice powder.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍລາບດິບໜຶ່ງຈານ
dishes.regional_note: Traditional delicacy loved by local connoisseurs
dishes.notes: Bile imparts a signature bitter flavor. Uncooked meat carries health risks.

dishes.name_local: ຂົ້ວໄຂ່ມົດແດງ
dishes.description: Plump white weaver ant larvae and eggs stir-fried with herbs, spring onions, chilies, and fish sauce.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍຂົ້ວໄຂ່ມົດແດງໜຶ່ງຈານ
dishes.regional_note: Seasonal delicacy available during late dry season (Feb–May)
dishes.notes: Ant eggs pop in the mouth with a slightly sour, creamy liquid flavor.

dishes.description: Mustard greens or cabbage fermented in cooked rice water and salt until sour, crunchy, and tangy.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍສົ້ມຜັກໜຶ່ງຈານ
dishes.regional_note: Home-style side dish served with grilled meats across Laos
dishes.notes: Naturally fermented probiotic side dish.

dishes.name_en: Steamed Beef Offal in Banana Leaf
dishes.description: Chopped beef offal, liver, and blood mixed with sticky rice powder, chilies, and herbs, wrapped and steamed in banana leaves.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍໝົກມ່າມໜຶ່ງຫໍ່
dishes.regional_note: Traditional rural night market wrapped dish
dishes.notes: Rich iron-heavy flavor profile for adventurous eaters.

dishes.name_local: ເຂົ້າໜົມຄົກ
dishes.description: Small round street cakes cooked in a dimpled cast-iron pan, made from rice flour batter and sweet coconut cream.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍເຂົ້າໜົມຄົກໜຶ່ງຊຸດ
dishes.regional_note: Popular morning and evening night market sweet street snack
dishes.notes: Crispy on the outside with a molten, custardy coconut interior.

dishes.description: Fermented rice vermicelli noodles in a fragrant red coconut curry broth made with pounded fish, lemongrass, and kaffir lime.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍເຂົ້າປຸ້ນໜຶ່ງຖ້ວຍ
dishes.regional_note: Festive dish eaten at celebrations and markets across Laos
dishes.notes: Top with shredded cabbage, banana flower, and long beans.

dishes.name_local: ແກ່ງໜໍ່ໄມ້
dishes.description: Dark savory soup made from fresh bamboo shoots boiled in a dark green extract of yanang leaves, thickened with sticky rice.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍແກ່ງໜໍ່ໄມ້ໜຶ່ງຖ້ວຍ
dishes.regional_note: Classic home-cooked soup eaten throughout Laos
dishes.notes: Yanang leaf juice gives the broth its distinctive earthy blackish-green color.

dishes.description: Whole Mekong fish stuffed with crushed lemongrass stalks and kaffir lime leaves, crusted with coarse sea salt and grilled over embers.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍປີ້ງປາໜຶ່ງໂຕ
dishes.regional_note: Riverside dining staple in Luang Prabang, Vang Vieng, and Vientiane
dishes.notes: Flaky white flesh dipped in spicy green chili garlic sauce.

dishes.description: Flaky, multi-layered French butter pastry baked fresh daily in French-influenced Laotian artisan bakeries.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍຄຣົວຊ່ອງໜຶ່ງບາດ
dishes.regional_note: Widely available at bakeries in Luang Prabang and Vientiane
dishes.notes: Reflects Laos' French colonial baking legacy.

dishes.description: Dark-roasted Bolaven Plateau Arabica and Robusta coffee brewed strong through a cloth filter, served over ice with condensed milk.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍກາເຟເຢັນໜຶ່ງແກ້ວ
dishes.regional_note: National coffee style using Southern Laos Bolaven coffee beans
dishes.notes: Very rich, sweet, and high in caffeine.

dishes.description: Iconic national Laotian rice-and-malted-barley lager beer (5% ABV), smooth and crisp.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍເບຍລາວໜຶ່ງແກ້ວ
dishes.regional_note: Served everywhere in Laos, often poured over ice cubes in hot weather
dishes.notes: Nearly ubiquitous emblem of Laotian beverage culture.

dishes.name_local: ນ້ຳໝາກມ່ວງປັ່ນ
dishes.description: Fresh sweet local mango blended with ice and syrup at roadside fruit stalls.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍນ້ຳໝາກມ່ວງປັ່ນໜຶ່ງແກ້ວ
dishes.regional_note: Extremely popular refreshment in Vang Vieng and Luang Prabang
dishes.notes: Ask 'bo sai nom' if you want it strictly dairy-free.

dishes.description: Naturally vibrant blue herbal tea made from dried butterfly pea blossoms, often served with lime juice turning it purple.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍນ້ຳອັນຊັນໜຶ່ງແກ້ວ
dishes.regional_note: Refreshing herbal cafe beverage across Lao cities
dishes.notes: Naturally caffeine-free and cooling.

dishes.description: Smashed cucumber strips pounded in a mortar with lime juice, chilies, garlic, and fermented fish paste.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍຕຳໝາກແຕງໜຶ່ງຈານ
dishes.regional_note: Hydrating spicy variation on papaya salad
dishes.notes: Very juicy and spicy; eaten with sticky rice to absorb sauce.

dishes.description: Sweetened sticky rice cooked in coconut milk, wrapped around ripe banana or black beans in banana leaves, and steamed.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍເຂົ້າຕົ້ມໜຶ່ງຫໍ່
dishes.regional_note: Common traditional market snack and temple offering
dishes.notes: Convenient portable travel snack.

dishes.name_local: ເຂົ້າປຽກເຂົ້າ
dishes.description: Comforting rice congee boiled in clear chicken broth, topped with ginger, spring onions, fried garlic, and black pepper.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍເຂົ້າປຽກເຂົ້າໜຶ່ງຖ້ວຍ
dishes.regional_note: Traditional soothing morning dish sold across all Lao towns
dishes.notes: Gentle on the stomach for travelers experiencing indigestion.

dishes.name_en: Lao Style Beef Pho Noodle Soup
dishes.description: Rice noodle soup in rich spiced beef bone broth, served with a large plate of fresh basil, mint, long beans, and shrimp paste.
dishes.order_phrase_local: ຂໍເຝີເລືອດໜຶ່ງຖ້ວຍ
dishes.regional_note: Vietnamese origin, adapted across Laos with raw herbs and shrimp paste
dishes.notes: Diners customize their broth at the table with lime, chili oil, and sugar.
